narrative: A coordinated network of 30 accounts using near-identical or identical message templates repeatedly targets a journalist (@asha_reports), labelling their reporting as 'corrupt', 'fake news', and 'defamatory' in a synchronised pile-on campaign under the hashtag #FakeNewsExposed, aiming to discredit and silence the journalist.

legal_suggestions.why: Multiple accounts posting identical or near-identical text in coordinated bursts indicates a criminal conspiracy to harass a single target.
legal_suggestions.title: Criminal conspiracy (coordinated action)

legal_suggestions.why: Posts publicly accuse the journalist of 'corrupt journalism' and spreading deliberate lies, which may constitute defamation under BNS 356.
legal_suggestions.title: Defamation

legal_suggestions.why: Repeated amplified claims that the journalist is spreading 'fake news' and 'dividing Sundarpur' could cause public alarm and mischief against the journalist's credibility and safety.
legal_suggestions.title: Statements conducing to public mischief (rumours causing fear or alarm)
